title: Claude Code Auto Mode Is On By Default: What the Data Shows
description:
Anthropic made auto mode the default on Pro, Max and Team on August 14. In their test across 1,053 paid users, auto mode caught 89% of harmful actions against 13.6% for human review.
It still stops for anything irreversible, destructive, or aimed outside your environment.

The safe plan, build, review workflow: https://aiserviceengine.com/lessons/plan-build-review
